note: Real recommended Aniimo team compositions, compiled from games.gg's best-teams guide. Each member's Held Item, personality and stat priority is pulled from our per-Aniimo build data (Game8), and each links to that Aniimo's full page. Team metas shift with patches — this is a curated snapshot, not auto-updated.

teams.name: Helion / Lunara Starter
teams.why: Turbo's Nimbi Burst buffs the team's damage right before your main DPS commits, while Glacy covers chip damage and keeps everyone topped up. A flexible fourth slot fills whatever the fight is missing — swap Helion for Lunara if you want a ranged carry.

teams.name: Rookey Dark Starter
teams.why: An all-Dark core: Fragrancier's debuffs and Witchin's curses feed Stellarys' energy and damage, while Rookey opens the break window. It scales cleanly out of the early game into mid-game content.

teams.name: Fenmane Lightning
teams.why: Blazen breaks enemy stance, Luminelle's Arc Surge buffs the team, and Fenmane cashes in the damage window. Note Besauce isn't an open-world catch at launch, and the team runs without a dedicated healer — lean on the break windows for safety.

teams.name: Sherro Water
teams.why: Panpanta and Piopiota flood the arena with water puddles that amplify Sherro's Water damage, while Prismana Glacy provides the sustain to keep the combo running through long fights.

teams.name: Fulmintis Lightning Burst
teams.why: A high-speed, no-healer Lightning team that breaks, double-buffs and slams the damage window shut fast. Brilliant for bursting down single targets — but fragile against sustained, multi-hit bosses where you can't out-race the incoming damage.

teams.name: Dreaple Dark Boss
teams.why: A dedicated boss-killer: two supports strip Dark resistance and buff the team, then Inferlupa opens the break window for Pawney's ultimate to land at full value.
